what: Clicking a same-site link turns the curtain on in .1s and a brand-colored panel covers the screen. Leaving a brand panel, it turns on in .3s (enter: fade). Leaving a paper panel, a center circle grows in .65s (enter: circle). Three center speech bubbles pop out from 0 scale, 80px below, at ∓50°, rotating about a bottom pivot over 1s with cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) (staggered 0, .12 and .2s). They float 25px and a few degrees back and forth (3s), hold for 1s, then move on. On the arrival page the bubbles tilt up 50px and ±10° and leave in .3s ease-in (.04s stagger). With a paper panel, a background-colored circle grows from the center in .65s to cover it (leave: circle). Then the whole curtain lifts after .5s over .3s. While the curtain is up, the cursor shows a wait shape and presses are blocked.

options.enter: Leaving mask type — fade (default, from the brand panel) · circle (from the paper panel, a center circle grows)
options.leave: Type on arrival — fade (default) · circle (a background-color circle wipe grows from the center to cover the screen)
options.hold: Dwell time after a click before advancing (seconds), default 1 — reduce it for screens flipped often (at 0 it advances mid-bounce)
options.each: Gap between speech bubbles on exit (s), default .04 — data-exit-delay if present
options.out-delay: Seconds from when the speech bubble starts dropping until the veil lifts, default .5
options.[data-fx-part=backdrop]: Brand color panel (required) — color is --fx-cover (default var(--kf-accent))
options.[data-fx-part=wipe]: (if present) leave: circle — a background-colored circle that grows, color is --fx-wipe (default var(--kf-bg))
options.[data-fx-part=bubble]: Bouncing speech bubbles (multiple) — data-delay (bounce delay) · data-rotate (initial tilt, default −50) · data-exit-rotate (tilt on exit, default 10) · data-exit-delay · data-bob (vertical float ”a,b”, default 0,25) · data-tilt (float tilt ”a,b”) · data-period (default 3) · data-bob-delay. Inside it, [data-fx-part=bob] one, with pieces inside it [data-fx-part=glyph] takes data-keys (“a,b,…” split evenly and cycled back and forth) · data-prop (rotate|scale) · data-period
options.[data-no-wipe]: Links inside this go straight through without a transition

from.where: shared.js·index.html·article.html .hm-loader — the original _app loader (framer-motion AnimatePresence: Container opacity .1s · Backdrop opacity .3s (first load) / clipPath circle 0→100% .65s (other loads) · three bubbles scale 0→1·y 80→0·rotate ∓50→0 1s [.19,1,.22,1] delayed .2·0·.12, floating y 0↔25·rotate 4/10/−10↔0 3s · exit opacity 0·y −50·rotate ±10 easeIn delayed 0·.08·.04 · Container exit .3s after .5s · waits 1s after the next screen is ready)
from.options: index: enter: fade; leave: fade · article: enter: circle; leave: circle

note: So the cover is already on from the very first frame of the landing page <head> Put one line in: <script>try{if(sessionStorage.getItem("fx-bubble-pop-page"))document.documentElement.classList.add("fx-bubble-arrive")}catch(e){}</script>. The original waits 1s after the next screen is ready (Next router), while the static page advances hold seconds after the press
